844a35: In Pedasia of Caria a sacrifice to Zeus is performed,
844b1: in which they send a certain she-goat, concerning which they say something wondrous
844b2: happens. For, setting out from Pedasa for seventy stadia
844b4: along its course it neither strays from the road, but while tied
844b5: with a rope it goes ahead of the one who holds the priesthood. Wondrous
844b6: and it is also wondrous that there are two ravens continually about the sanctuary of Zeus
